messages:
Nadia Flores: Quick idea: add a "density contours" overlay toggle in the legend for heatmaps and area charts. Itd help highlight clusters without changing the color ramp. Also add an "export overflow" action on the overflow badge to download the outlier list as CSV. Thoughts? Ben Cho: Love both. Contours are great for pattern recognition. Implementation note: render contours on a separate canvas layer so they can be toggled cheaply. Riley Adams: Accessibility: when overflow count changes (e.g., brush/filter), we should announce updates via aria-live so screen readers know counts changed. Example: ```
Overflow: 12 items
``` Nadia Flores: Exactly. Also microcopy for export: button text = "Export overflow (CSV)"; tooltip = "Download list of points outside the scale". Keep it short. Sam Ortega: UX question: how do contours interact with smoothing? If smoothing is on, contours could hide single-point spikes. Maybe contours reflect raw density, with an option "Contours (raw) / (smoothed)" in the legend menu. Ben Cho: Good call. Default = raw contours so spikes still show, with toggle to use smoothed kernel for overview. Add a small legend chip when contours are enabled: "Contours: raw". Riley Adams: For keyboard, contour toggle must be reachable via Tab and announce state changes: "Density contours enabled, using raw data". Overflow export should open a small dialog with a Confirm button and an aria-describedby that lists columns. Nadia Flores: Also propose a per-user contrast mode: a legend option "High contrast textures" that applies stronger outlines and optional patterns; it should persist per-user. Useful for low-vision viewers. Sam Ortega: Dev note: export endpoint should accept current filter/brush range and return a CSV stream. We'll implement server-side to avoid shipping huge arrays to the client. Add rate-limit and warn if export > 100k rows. Ben Cho: Canvas rendering tip: keep contour generation in a web worker (marching squares) and send back an alpha mask. That avoids main-thread jank. Riley Adams: Microcopy for aria-live: "Overflow updated: 12 items. Use Export to download list." Also include instructions in the overflow panel: "Press Enter to open actions". Nadia Flores: Decision: 1) Add density contours toggle in legend with raw/smoothed option. 2) Overflow badge gets Export CSV action + small confirm dialog. 3) Announce overflow updates with aria-live. 4) Per-user high-contrast textures toggle. 5) Implement contour generation in worker + canvas layer. Action items: Ben prototype worker flow, Riley write ARIA strings and dialog copy, Sam spec export API, I'll add figma frames. Designbot: Pushed figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-density/contours-overflow-export frame: legend/contours-export-v1 :sparkles: Nadia Flores: Thanks all I'll open the design ticket and attach the new frames.
